subject: mathematics
concept: Building a mathematical model from a real-world scenario, defining variables and constraints
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies all relevant quantities in a realistic scenario and labels them as variables or fixed constraints
exercise.pictorial: Student organizes a scenario's information into a variables/constraints chart before modeling
exercise.abstract: Student defines variables and constraints for a given real-world scenario as the first step toward a model

misconception_flags: treats a genuine variable as a fixed constraint, or vice versa

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
